claim_text: Liver memory NK: existence and origin

audit.primary_source_citation: PRIMARY (existence): O'Leary JG, Goodarzi M, Drayton DL, von Andrian UH. "T cell- and B cell-independent adaptive immunity mediated by natural killer cells." Nat Immunol 2006;7(5):507-16. doi:10.1038/ni1332. PMID 16617337. — SUPPORTING CHAIN whose methods I DID read: Paust S et al. Nat Immunol 2010;11:1127-35, PMID 20972432 / PMC2982944 (virus + hapten memory, CXCR6); Peng H et al. J Clin Invest 2013;123:1444-56, PMID 23524967 (CD49a+DX5- liver subset, parabiosis); Sojka DK et al. eLife 2014;3:e01659, PMID 24714492 / PMC3975579 (parabiosis, Eomes-/T-bet, lineage distinct); Klose CSN et al. Cell 2014;157:340-56, PMID 24725403 (CHILP -> NKp46+IL-7Ra+ ILC1, NOT cNK); Wang X et al. Nat Commun 2018;9:4854, PMID 30451860 / PMC6242895 (memory function assigned to IL-7Ra+ ILC1); Cuff AO et al. J Immunol 2016;197:4283-91, PMID 27798170 / PMC5114885 (human liver residency); Ly49C/I depletion study, J Immunol 2025;214:1802, PMID 40381992.
audit.fulltext_unavailable_reason: O'Leary 2006 (PMID 16617337) has NO PMC deposit (pre-2008 NIH public-access mandate) and is paywalled at Nature. SEARCHED AND COULD NOT OBTAIN: lit.py methods 16617337 returned STATUS=ABSTRACT_ONLY (archived /home/user/aaa/refs/P3_16617337.txt, abstract+MeSH only); WebFetch on https://doi.org/10.1038/ni1332 and https://www.nature.com/articles/ni1332 both 302/303-redirect to idp.nature.com institutional login; a targeted WebSearch for the transferred-cell numbers returned only citing reviews, no methods text. I therefore have ZERO methods text for the primary and refuse to paraphrase its abstract as if it were methods. Methods for the immediate successor from the same lab and same protocol (Paust 2010) WERE obtained in full from the PMC author manuscript PMC2982944, and methods for Peng 2013, Sojka 2014, Wang 2018 and Cuff 2016 were obtained in full; the quantitative fields below are grounded in those, not in O'Leary.
audit.species: Mouse for all memory/origin experiments: C57BL/6, BALB/c, Rag1-/-, Rag2-/-, Rag2-/-Il2rg-/-, Cxcr6-/- and Cxcr6gfp/gfp, Cxcr3-/-, Tbx21-/-, Nfil3-/-, Il15ra-/-, Gata3fl/fl-Vav-Cre, CD45.1/CD45.2 congenics. Human only for the tissue-residency arm (Cuff 2016: liver transplant donor/recipient pairs; Marquardt 2015 PMID 25672754; Stegmann 2016 PMID 27210614).
audit.what_was_measured: In mouse, in vivo, hepatic mononuclear cells were prepared by 40-um filtration + Nycodenz gradient from hapten- or virus-sensitized donors, sorted on the gate CD45+ NK1.1+ CD3-/TCR- (Paust 2010) and 8x10^4 cells transferred i.v. into naive Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- recipients; readout at 24-48 h was ear-swelling (caliper, micrometres) after DNFB or oxazolone challenge, and separately survival curves after lethal homologous vs heterologous influenza/VSV challenge, in n=8-10 recipient mice per group. In mouse, in vivo, liver CD3-CD19-CD122+ cells were split into CD49a+DX5- vs CD49a-DX5+ and 8x10^4 sorted cells from OXA-sensitized donors were transferred into naive B6, challenged 1 month later, ear-swelling readout, n=4 mice per group; in parallel CD45.1/CD45.2 parabionts were joined for 14 days and allotype composition of each liver subset was scored in 7 parabiotic pairs (Peng 2013), and 14-day parabiosis with the same readout in 8 pairs across two experiments (Sojka 2014). In mouse, in vivo, at 1 month post-sensitization, 5x10^4 cells sorted as CD3-NK1.1+NKp46+CD49a+IL-7Ra+ (ILC1), IL-7Ra- CD49a+ (LrNK) or cNK from OXA-sensitized Rag1-/- donors were transferred into naive recipients and ear thickness measured every 24 h, n=4-6 mice per group (Wang 2018). In human, ex vivo, donor- vs recipient-origin leukocytes were discriminated by anti-HLA-A2/A3 staining of perfusate, biopsy and explant from 7 HLA-mismatched liver transplants plus 5 re-transplant explants (longest interval 13 years), scoring Eomes, T-bet, CXCR6, CD69, CD49a, CD56, CD16 by flow; plus a 7-day IL-15 +/- IL-12 +/- TGF-b culture of sorted Eomes-lo NK cells scoring Eomes upregulation (Cuff 2016).
audit.n: O'Leary 2006 (primary): NOT VERIFIABLE, methods paywalled. Paust 2010: n=8-10 recipient mice per group. Peng 2013: n=4 mice per group for the CHS adoptive transfer; 7 parabiotic pairs; syngeneic/mixed BM chimeras 10^6 cells per arm. Sojka 2014: 8 parabiotic pairs total (2 independent experiments x 4 pairs). Wang 2018: n=4-6 mice per group. Cuff 2016: 7 HLA-mismatched liver transplant donor/recipient pairs + 5 re-transplant explants.
audit.n_unit: mice per group (adoptive-transfer recipients); parabiotic mouse pairs; human liver-transplant donor/recipient pairs. NOT cells — the 8x10^4 / 5x10^4 / 10^6 figures are transferred cell doses, not n.
audit.controls: Paust 2010: mock (no-cell) recipients of Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- confirmed absent NK1.1+ cells; splenic and naive-donor NK cells as non-memory transfer controls; challenge with a non-sensitizing hapten and with a heterologous virus as antigen-specificity controls; Cxcr6-/- donors as the genetic arm. Peng 2013: paired CD49a- DX5+ liver subset transferred in parallel as the internal negative control; congenic CD45.1/CD45.2 allotype discrimination in parabionts; syngeneic BM transplant to test bone-marrow origin. Sojka 2014: circulating CD49a-DX5+ subset in the same parabiont as the internal equilibration control; Tbx21-/-, Nfil3-/-, Il15ra-/- as genetic requirement controls. Wang 2018: three sorted populations (cNK, IL-7Ra- LrNK, IL-7Ra+ ILC1, all >=95% purity) transferred side-by-side from the same donors — this is the only design in the chain that can actually attribute memory to one of the three. Cuff 2016: non-transplanted liver perfusate and paired pre-/post-transplant biopsies. MISSING THROUGHOUT: no clonal barcoding, no Cre-lox fate map, no live imaging of a single cell acquiring the memory state; no experiment in which a purified naive cell of defined lineage is followed to a memory cell.
audit.strongest_alternative_explanation: The claim splits into two parts that carry very different evidential weight, and the weak half is the one the label "NK" sits on. (1) EXISTENCE of a transferable, antigen-specific, liver-restricted memory population in T/B-deficient mice is genuinely supported by OBS_TRANSFER, replicated in four labs. (2) The ORIGIN/IDENTITY as "NK cell" is only INF_MARKER, and the marker panel used to establish it is provably incapable of the distinction: Paust 2010 gated CD45+NK1.1+CD3-/TCR- with NO CD49a and NO DX5, a gate that pools conventional NK cells and liver ILC1s. The strongest alternative is therefore an ENTITY MISASSIGNMENT rather than a false transition: the memory-mediating cell is a pre-existing, tissue-resident, Eomes- T-bet+ CD49a+DX5- IL-7Ra+ ILC1 that was never a conventional NK cell and never "became" anything — it was simply present in the liver, selected/expanded by sensitization, and mis-gated as NK. This is exactly the canonical "pre-existing subset selected rather than converted" alternative, and it is the one the data now favour: Wang 2018, sorting cNK vs IL-7Ra- LrNK vs IL-7Ra+ ILC1 from the same donors, found ONLY the IL-7Ra+ CD49a+ ILC1 fraction conferred hapten recall; Klose 2014 showed that NKp46+IL-7Ra+ T-bet-dependent lineage arises from the Id2+ CHILP, which explicitly does NOT give rise to cNK; Sojka 2014 showed the CD49a+DX5- liver cells stay host-restricted across 14-day parabiosis and are Eomes-negative. A second, independent alternative applies to the ORIGIN sub-claim specifically: Peng 2013's assertion that these cells derive from hepatic HPC/HSC rather than bone marrow rests on a BM-chimera reconstitution deficit ("less than 15% DX5- NK cells"), which is equally explained by failure of a radioresistant resident population to be replaced under irradiation — i.e. residency/radioresistance, not local hepatic ontogeny — and is superseded by the CHILP-origin result. A third alternative is a species artefact in the human extrapolation: the human liver-resident population is T-bet-lo Eomes-HI (Cuff 2016; Stegmann 2016), the OPPOSITE transcription-factor polarity to the mouse T-bet-hi Eomes-NEGATIVE ILC1, so "liver memory NK cell" in mouse and "liver-resident NK cell" in human are not the same entity and the mouse ILC1 reassignment does not transfer.
audit.counter_evidence: FOUND, and it is decisive for the identity half of the claim. (a) Peng 2013 (JCI, PMID 23524967) — with Sojka and Yokoyama as co-authors — opens by conceding "the phenotype and origin of these 'memory' NK cells cannot be distinguished from other NK cell subpopulations", then localises the memory to CD49a+DX5- cells whose microarray shows Eomes "expressed at much higher levels in DX5+ NK cells", i.e. the memory-bearing subset is Eomes-low. (b) Sojka 2014 (eLife, PMID 24714492): 14-day parabiosis, 8 pairs — "Host CD49a+DX5- NK cells were primarily found in the indicated host tissue" while "CD49a-DX5+ NK cells of both allotypes were found in both parabionts"; combined with Tbx21-/-, Nfil3-/-, Il15ra-/- requirements this defines them as a lineage distinct from thymic and conventional splenic NK. (c) Daussy 2014 (JEM, PMID 24516120): T-bet and Eomes instruct two distinct liver vs bone-marrow group-1 lineages. (d) Klose 2014 (Cell, PMID 24725403) is the hardest ontogeny counter-evidence: the Id2+ CHILP "differentiated into ILC2 and ILC3 lineages, but not into conventional natural killer (cNK) cells", instead giving rise to "a peculiar NKp46+ IL-7Ra+ ILC lineage that required T-bet for specification and was distinct of cNK cells" — so the cell now credited with liver hapten memory does not descend from the NK progenitor at all. (e) Wang 2018 (Nat Commun, PMID 30451860), from Tian/Peng's own group, transfers the memory function outright: "LN IL-7Ra+ ILC1s, rather than IL-7Ra- cNK cells, conferred long-term recall responses", with the memory cells T-bet+Eomes-; note also that the "novel lineage-tracing model" phrasing in the preprint/press title is not supported by its methods, which list no reporter or Cre strain, only CD45.1/CD45.2 congenic transfer. (f) Cell Rep 2024 (PMID 38363684) continues the reassignment, framing the population as RORa-dependent ILC1s. (g) Contemporaneous ADMISSION from the pro-NK camp: J Immunol 2025 (PMID 40381992), which re-tests O'Leary's Ly49C-I claim, states outright that "the current known markers of memory NK cells cannot adequately discriminate between conventional NK cells and memory NK cells, making this question difficult to answer" and concedes the memory population may be "a distinct ILC subset" — as of 2025 the founding lab's lineage does not claim the entity is resolved. (h) Human counter-evidence to a direct mouse-to-human read-across: Cuff 2016 (PMID 27798170) shows human liver-resident NK are T-bet-lo Eomes-HI, retained up to 13 years, yet "can be recruited from the circulation during adult life", with sorted Eomes-lo cells upregulating Eomes in 7-day IL-15/IL-12/TGF-b culture — a residency + in vitro conversion result of the opposite TF polarity to mouse ILC1. NOT FOUND, distinguished from does-not-exist: I searched specifically for a failure-to-replicate or artefact critique of the hapten-CHS memory phenomenon itself ("NK cell memory hapten controversy failed reproduce"; "contact hypersensitivity Rag deficient mice B-1 cells exosomes hapten specific antibody Askenase") and read no such paper — I record this as a search run with nothing found, NOT as evidence that no such critique exists.
audit.downstream_dependency: Named, concrete dependents: (1) Paust 2010's virus-antigen arm (influenza/VSV/HIV-1 VLP sensitisation giving homologous-only survival protection) is the explicit foundation of the "NK cells as a vaccine target" programme — it is the load-bearing citation in Paust & von Andrian, Nat Immunol 2011;12:500 "Natural killer cell memory", and downstream in the humanised-mouse human-NK antigen-specific memory work; if the effector is ILC1 rather than NK, the entire NK-directed vaccination rationale is targeting the wrong lineage. (2) Peng 2013's specific origin claim that these cells "appeared to originate from hepatic hematopoietic progenitor/stem cells (HPCs/HSCs) but not from the bone marrow" is a named, testable downstream assertion that is directly contradicted by Klose 2014's CHILP-origin result and by Sojka 2014. (3) The CD49a+DX5- "liver-resident NK cell" label propagated as a cell-type definition into human liver immunology and into single-cell atlases (e.g. Cell Discov 2020, PMID 32351704, "Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals the heterogeneity of liver-resident immune cells in human"; Marquardt 2015 PMID 25672754), where an ILC1 population annotated as "liver-resident NK" systematically corrupts group-1 ILC cell-type calls. (4) The ILC1-memory literature built on the reassignment — Wang 2018 Nat Commun PMID 30451860 and Cell Rep 2024 PMID 38363684 (RORa-dependent ILC1 memory via a lymph node-liver axis) — inherits the phenomenon but under a different lineage label, so any downstream meta-analysis that pools "liver memory NK" and "memory ILC1" papers is double-counting one population under two names. (5) The Ly49C/I requirement (O'Leary 2006, re-tested in J Immunol 2025 PMID 40381992) is used as the putative antigen-recognition module for adaptive NK responses; it is assayed by antibody depletion of a PRE-EXISTING Ly49C/I+ subset, which supports selection of a standing subset rather than conversion.
audit.audit_overturns_detail: Claude's call ("LINEAGE IDENTITY DISPUTED — they may be ILC1") is directionally right but is both too weak and insufficiently decomposed, and it misses the strongest half of the evidence. THREE CORRECTIONS. (1) UNDERSTATED: this is not a live 50/50 dispute. The single best-controlled experiment in the chain — Wang 2018, three populations sorted to >=95% purity from the SAME donors and transferred side-by-side, n=4-6 mice/group — attributes hapten memory specifically to IL-7Ra+ CD49a+ T-bet+Eomes- ILC1 and explicitly excludes IL-7Ra- cNK; Klose 2014 shows that lineage descends from the Id2+ CHILP which does NOT produce cNK; and the pro-NK camp itself conceded in 2025 (PMID 40381992) that "the current known markers of memory NK cells cannot adequately discriminate between conventional NK cells and memory NK cells." The mouse hapten-memory effector is best read as ILC1, not cNK. (2) UNDER-DECOMPOSED: the claim has two halves with opposite grades and Claude collapsed them. EXISTENCE of a transferable liver-restricted antigen-specific memory population is OBS_TRANSFER and survives the audit intact across four independent labs — Claude's framing risks implying the phenomenon itself is in doubt; it is not, only the label on the cell is. ORIGIN/IDENTITY is INF_MARKER only, and the founding gate (Paust 2010: "CD45+ NK1.1+ CD3- or TCR-", with NO CD49a and NO DX5) is mechanically incapable of separating cNK from ILC1, so the word "NK" in "liver memory NK cells" was never measured — it was assumed by a gate. (3) MISSED SPECIES DISCORDANCE: Claude's note to check human liver NK residency resolves against a simple ILC1 read-across. Human liver-resident NK are T-bet-lo Eomes-HI (Cuff 2016, 7 HLA-mismatched transplants + 5 explants, retained 13 years; Stegmann 2016), the OPPOSITE TF polarity to mouse T-bet-hi Eomes-NEGATIVE ILC1, and Cuff further shows they are replenishable from circulating Eomes-lo NK (in vivo recruitment plus 7-day in vitro Eomes upregulation, INF_INVITRO). So "mouse liver memory NK = ILC1" does not license "human liver-resident NK = ILC1". FINALLY, on the hint list: the hint's attributions check out (O'Leary 2006 = PMID 16617337; Paust 2010 = PMID 20972432; Peng 2013 JCI = PMID 23524967; Sojka 2014 eLife = PMID 24714492, parabiosis + Eomes/T-bet as described), with one correction — the hint credits Peng 2013 with the ILC1 reassignment, but Peng 2013 still calls the cells "liver-resident NK cells" and asserts a hepatic HSC origin; the actual reassignment is carried by Klose 2014 (ontogeny), Sojka/Daussy 2014 (lineage and TF), and Wang 2018 (memory function). Note also that Wang 2018 is widely described as a "lineage-tracing model" but its methods contain no reporter or Cre strain, only CD45.1/CD45.2 congenic transfer — so even the strongest identity experiment is OBS_TRANSFER, not OBS_DIRECT. No OBS_DIRECT evidence (barcoding, clonal tracking, live imaging, genetic fate map of an individual cell acquiring the memory state) exists anywhere in this claim.
audit.methods_quote: Paust 2010 (PMC2982944, Methods) — the founding gate, which cannot separate cNK from ILC1: "CD45+ NK1.1+ CD3- or TCR-, and sometimes also Thy1+ and/or gfp+"; "8x10^4 splenic or hepatic CD45+ NK1.1+ NK-cells were adoptively transferred to naive Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- mice"; "n=8-10 recipients/group". CD49a and DX5/CD49b appear nowhere in the identification or sorting. // Sojka 2014 (PMC3975579, Materials and methods): "day 14 post parabiosis surgery"; "The experiment was performed two independent times with four parabiosed animals in each experiment (total of 8 pairs)"; "Host CD49a+ DX5- NK cells were primarily found in the indicated host tissue" whereas "CD49a-DX5+ NK cells of both allotypes were found in both parabionts". // Peng 2013 (JCI 66381, Methods): "WT (CD45.2+) and CD45.1+ B6 female mice controlled for age and weight were parabiosed for 14 days"; "represents 7 parabiotic pairs"; "Naive B6 mice received 8 x 10^4 CD49a+ or CD49a- liver NK cells from OXA-sensitized WT mice and were challenged 1 month later (n = 4 per group)"; "Eomes ... was expressed at much higher levels in DX5+ NK cells". // Wang 2018 (PMC6242895, Methods): gate "CD3-NK1.1+NKp46+CD49a+IL-7Ra+"; "5 x 10^4 liver cNK cells, IL-7Ra- LrNK cells, or IL-7Ra+ ILC1s from OXA-sensitized Rag1-/- donors"; n=4-6 per group; result "LN IL-7Ra+ ILC1s, rather than IL-7Ra- cNK cells, conferred long-term recall responses". // Klose 2014 (PMID 24725403): the CHILP "differentiated into ILC2 and ILC3 lineages, but not into conventional natural killer (cNK) cells ... Instead, the CHILP gave rise to a peculiar NKp46+ IL-7Ralpha+ ILC lineage that required T-bet for specification and was distinct of cNK cells". // Cuff 2016 (PMC5114885, Methods): 7 HLA-mismatched liver transplants plus 5 re-transplant explants, donor vs recipient "by staining with Abs specific for the mismatched HLA" (HLA-A2/A3), Eomes-hi retained "up to 13 y", liver-resident phenotype "T-bet-lo Eomes-hi", sorted cells "cultured for 7 d" with IL-15 +/- IL-12 (50 ng/ml) +/- TGF-b (5 ng/ml). // J Immunol 2025 (PMID 40381992), the field's own current admission: "The current known markers of memory NK cells cannot adequately discriminate between conventional NK cells and memory NK cells, making this question difficult to answer."
audit.notes: ARCHIVED FULL TEXT under /home/user/aaa/refs/ with tag P3: P3_16617337.txt (O'Leary 2006, ABSTRACT_ONLY — no methods, see fulltext_unavailable_reason), P3_PMC2982944.txt (Paust 2010), P3_PMC3613925.txt (Peng 2013, abstract-only via PMC; methods recovered by WebFetch from jci.org/articles/view/66381), P3_PMC3975579.txt (Sojka 2014, OA_FULLTEXT), P3_PMC6242895.txt (Wang 2018, OA_FULLTEXT), P3_PMC3949572.txt (Daussy 2014, OA_FULLTEXT), P3_24725403.txt (Klose 2014, abstract-only), P3_PMC5114885.txt (Cuff 2016, abstract-only via lit.py; methods recovered by WebFetch from PMC). Note that lit.py reported STATUS=OA_FULLTEXT but returned near-empty Methods bodies for Sojka, Wang and Daussy (254, 78 and 375 chars respectively) because those journals nest the methods text in sub-sections the parser does not descend into; the methods content for those three was recovered by WebFetch against the PMC article pages, which is what the quotes above are drawn from. RECOMMENDED ROW REWRITE: the claim as phrased ("Liver memory NK cells: their existence and their origin") should be split before grading, because grading it as one unit averages an OBS_TRANSFER-supported phenomenon with an INF_MARKER-only entity assignment and produces a misleadingly high composite. Suggested split: P3a "A liver-restricted, transferable, antigen-specific memory population exists in T/B-deficient mice" = OBS_TRANSFER, holds; P3b "That population is a conventional NK cell" = INF_MARKER, does not hold, best current assignment is CHILP-derived Eomes- T-bet+ CD49a+ IL-7Ra+ ILC1; P3c "It originates from hepatic HPC/HSC rather than bone marrow" (Peng 2013) = contradicted by Klose 2014; P3d "Human liver-resident NK cells are the same entity" = not supported, opposite Eomes/T-bet polarity and demonstrably replenished from circulation. Also worth flagging for the screen: NOT ONE paper in this chain uses barcoding, clonal tracking, live imaging or a genetic fate map, so no OBS_DIRECT evidence exists for any part of this claim, and the frequently repeated description of Wang 2018 as a "lineage-tracing model" is not supported by its methods.

adv.challenge_reason:
I re-pulled the methods myself rather than trusting the row. Three findings.

(1) THE ROW'S CATEGORICAL "NO OBS_DIRECT EXISTS ANYWHERE IN THIS CLAIM" IS FALSE. Flommersfeld et al., Immunity 2021 (PMID 34437840 / PMC8528403; archived /home/user/aaa/refs/P3_PMC8528403.txt; lit.py's METHOD_HEADS parser truncated the body to 297 chars, so I recovered it by WebFetch of the PMC page) is genuine single-cell clonal fate mapping: HSCs transduced with retroviral fluorescent colour barcodes (GFP/YFP/CFP/Ametrine/EBFP2) into irradiated hosts, then SINGLE colour-barcoded CD27+Ly49H+ NK cells sorted and adoptively transferred; readout = progeny of each clone after MCMV. n = 82 NK-cell clones from 6-12 recipient mice per experiment across seven independent experiments (54 clones / four experiments for the core fate-map panels). Liver was analysed (Fig. S6E: both lineages homed there and "retain[ed] their distinct lineage-specific phenotypes"); both fates "robustly re-expanded" on secondary MCMV challenge. That is same-clone-followed-to-progeny = OBS_DIRECT, on exactly the NK-vs-ILC1 origin question the row declared unresolvable.

(2) THE ROW MISSED THE ONE TRUE "TRANSFER A, RECOVER B" EXPERIMENT IN THE FIELD. Sun, Beilke & Lanier, Nature 2009 (PMID 19136945 / PMC2674434; lit.py methods body = 438 chars, recovered by WebFetch): 10^4-10^5 congenic CD45.1+ NAIVE WT NK cells -> DAP12-deficient CD45.2+ recipients -> MCMV -> "a long-lived 'memory' pool of NK cells that can persist in lymphoid as well as non-lymphoid tissues such as the liver", ~1000-fold expansion in LIVER vs ~100-fold in spleen at 40-50 d; memory cells then re-sorted (CD45.1+) and serially re-transferred into a second DAP12-deficient host giving >100-fold secondary expansion; 3-5 mice per timepoint, representative of 3 experiments. The input is the PRE-transition cell and the output is the POST-transition cell, congenically tracked. That is the OBS_TRANSFER the hapten chain never performs, and the row cites neither it nor the whole MCMV liver-memory literature.

(3) CONVERSELY, THE ROW'S OBS_TRANSFER CREDIT FOR THE HAPTEN CHAIN IS PARTLY UNEARNED AND SHOULD BE DOWNGRADED FOR THE TRANSITION SUB-CLAIM. In O'Leary 2006 / Paust 2010 / Peng 2013 / Wang 2018 the transferred cell is ALREADY the sensitized/memory cell and the recipient readout is ear thickness in micrometres — a FUNCTION, not the appearance of cell type B. I verified against Paust 2010's Online Methods (WebFetch PMC2982944): gate "CD45+ NK1.1+ CD3- or TCR-, and sometimes also Thy1+ and/or gfp+"; panel = NK1.1, TCRb/TCRd or CD3, Thy1, CD45, Lamp-1, CXCR6; CD49a and DX5/CD49b absent (row correct here); NO experiment transferring naive NK cells and generating memory inside the recipient; NO re-isolation/re-phenotyping of transferred cells. So nothing in the hapten chain observes any cell becoming anything.

MINOR CORRECTIONS TO THE ROW'S OWN NUMBERS, verified against source: Paust 2010 Online Methods as retrieved states "n=10-15 recipients/group" (row asserts a verbatim "n=8-10 recipients/group" — I could not reproduce that string). Wang 2018 (archived P3_PMC6242895.txt, Methods read directly): recipients were "sub-lethally irradiated (6.5 Gy)", NOT "naive" as the row states — the same irradiation confound the row itself levels at Peng 2013's BM chimeras; "For most experiments, 3-10 age- and sex-matched mice were used. No exclusion, randomization, or blinding were performed"; the "5 x 10^4" dose and "n = 4-5 in each group" appear only in figure legends (Fig. 1d, 4b), not Methods (row says n=4-6). Row's claim that Wang 2018 contains no Cre/reporter fate map is UPHELD — strains are B6, Rag1-/-, CD45.1, Cxcr6gfp/gfp, Cxcr3-/-, Rag1-/-Cxcr3-/-, CD45.1+CD45.2+.

G2 FLAG THE ROW MISSED: Flommersfeld 2021's "separate lineage" conclusion rests partly on RNA velocity ("indicated that this ILC1-like cluster showed almost no differentiation activity toward cNK cells"). Under G2 that is INF_TRAJECTORY and cannot license a lineage-separation conclusion; INF_TRAJECTORY must be added to evidence_types_all.

adv.revised_evidence_type_strongest: OBS_DIRECT — but scope-qualified, and the row must be decomposed to avoid averaging. (a) ORIGIN/IDENTITY of the liver group-1 memory compartment: OBS_DIRECT exists — Flommersfeld 2021 (PMID 34437840), single-cell retroviral colour-barcode clonal fate mapping of Ly49H+ NK cells, 82 clones / 6-12 recipient mice per experiment / 7 independent experiments, MCMV primary and secondary challenge, liver included (Fig. S6E). (b) NAIVE NK -> LIVER MEMORY NK transition: OBS_TRANSFER of the true transfer-A-recover-B kind — Sun 2009 (PMID 19136945), congenic CD45.1 naive NK -> DAP12-/- CD45.2 recipients, memory recovered from liver at 40-50 d (~1000-fold), serial re-transfer, 3-5 mice/timepoint x 3 experiments. (c) HAPTEN/CHS liver memory specifically: ceiling is OBS_TRANSFER-of-FUNCTION only (sensitized cells in, ear swelling in micrometres out; n = 4-5 mice/group, Wang 2018 Fig. 1d) plus OBS_GENETIC for requirement (Cxcr6-/-, Cxcr3-/-, Tbx21-/-, Nfil3-/-, Il15ra-/-, and independently Nlrp3-/-/Asc-/-/Il18-/- in van den Boorn 2016). (d) THE WORD "NK" IN "LIVER MEMORY NK CELL": still INF_MARKER only — row correct. evidence_types_all should read OBS_DIRECT, OBS_TRANSFER, OBS_GENETIC, INF_MARKER, INF_TRAJECTORY, INF_INVITRO.
adv.new_counter_evidence:
SIX items the row missed, four of which point AWAY from the row's confident ILC1 reassignment and toward the canonical "pre-existing subset selected, not converted" alternative.

(1) THE DECISIVE SELECTION-NOT-CONVERSION EXPERIMENT IS INSIDE THE ROW'S OWN BEST-CONTROLLED PAPER AND THE ROW DOES NOT REPORT IT. Wang 2018 (PMID 30451860 / PMC6242895), Supplementary Fig. 5c,d, verbatim from the archived full text: "naive CD45.2+ splenic cNK cells were transferred into naive CD45.1 mice. Upon hapten sensitization, donor cells in recipient LNs did not acquire IL-7Ra and CD49a expression, maintaining their cNK cell phenotype, suggesting that cNK cells did not convert into ILC1s in the CHS model." A congenic transfer purpose-built to test the conversion, returning a NEGATIVE. This is the single strongest piece of evidence in the whole chain that no cNK -> memory-ILC1 conversion occurs.

(2) WANG 2018'S OWN KINETICS SAY REDISTRIBUTION, NOT CONVERSION AND NOT CLONAL EXPANSION: Ki67 unchanged when LN ILC1 numbers peak ("suggesting that the increase of IL-7Ra+ ILC1s was not due to clonal expansion"); the liver increase "may be a consequence of cell migration, rather than local proliferation"; contraction with no rise in 7AAD+ apoptosis, i.e. egress; recruitment CXCR3-dependent and abolished in Cxcr3-/-; egress S1PR1/FTY720-sensitive; the whole liver memory increase abrogated by lymphadenectomy or LTbR-Ig-induced LN deficiency. So "memory formation" here is trafficking of a standing pool along an LN-liver axis — textbook selection/redistribution of a pre-existing subset.

(3) WANG 2018'S PARABIOSIS CONTRADICTS THE ROW'S "RESIDENT THEREFORE SEPARATE LINEAGE" READING OF SOJKA 2014: CD45.1/CD45.2 parabionts, 2 weeks, then OXA — "donor-derived ILC1s increased up to 30%" and the authors "conclude that LN ILC1s may be partially recruited from blood."

(4) INDEPENDENT REPLICATION THE ROW NEITHER FOUND NOR CREDITED: van den Boorn JG, ..., Garbi N, Hartmann G, Hornung V. "Inflammasome-Dependent Induction of Adaptive NK Cell Memory." Immunity 2016;44:1406-21, PMID 27287410 (Bonn/LMU — independent of both von Andrian and Tian/Peng). Monobenzone pro-hapten; long-lasting melanocyte-specific response, NK-dependent, "fully intact in the absence of T- and B cells"; memory NK "resided in the liver and transfer of these cells conferred melanocyte-specific immunity to naive animals"; abolished by macrophage depletion or loss of NLRP3, ASC or IL-18. This is a third independent lab and it STRENGTHENS the existence half. CAVEAT (G1): I have abstract only (archived P3_27287410.txt); I did NOT read its methods.

(5) THE ROW'S ONTOGENY VERDICT IS OUT OF DATE AND POINTS THE WRONG WAY. The row states Peng 2013's hepatic-HPC/HSC origin claim "is directly contradicted by Klose 2014's CHILP-origin result". Bai L, ..., Vivier E, Peng H, Sun R, Tian Z. "Liver type 1 innate lymphoid cells develop locally via an interferon-g-dependent loop." Science 2021;371:eaba4177, PMID 33766856: adult mouse liver contains fetal-liver-derived Lin-Sca-1+Mac-1+ HSCs, "includes Lin-CD122+CD49a+ progenitors that can generate liver ILC1s but not conventional natural killer cells", with IFN-g from the ILC1s themselves driving development in situ. That REHABILITATES local hepatic origin rather than refuting it, and it is not in conflict with a CHILP-type progenitor being resident in liver. CAVEAT (G1): Science is paywalled and there is no PMC deposit; WebFetch on science.org/doi/10.1126/science.aba4177 returned HTTP 403. I have ABSTRACT ONLY and did not read its methods — I record it as a pointer, not as verified methods.

(6) NK<->ILC1 IS A DEMONSTRATED PLASTIC AXIS, SO THE ROW'S MARKER-BASED REASSIGNMENT IS NOT LICENSED EITHER. Gao Y et al., Nat Immunol 2017;18:1004, PMID 28759001: "TGF-b-signaling-dependent conversion of NK cells (CD49a-CD49b+Eomes+) into intermediate type 1 innate lymphoid cell (intILC1) (CD49a+CD49b+Eomes+) populations and ILC1 (CD49a+CD49b-Eomes-int) populations in the tumor microenvironment." Cortez VS et al., Nat Immunol 2017;18:995, PMID 28759002: Smad4-deficient NK cells "unexpectedly acquired an ILC1-like gene signature". Cortez VS et al., Immunity 2016;44:1127, PMID 27156386: TGF-b imprints the salivary-gland ILC1 program. CD49a+ DX5- Eomes-low is therefore a TGF-b-INDUCIBLE STATE, and "CD49a+DX5-, therefore never a cNK" is a non-sequitur. Note items (1) and (6) cut in opposite directions: together they mean the identity question is genuinely OPEN, not settled toward ILC1 as the row asserts.

(7) SELECTION OF A PRE-EXISTING GERMLINE-RECEPTOR SUBSET IS WHAT THE FIELD'S STRONGEST DATA ACTUALLY SHOW. Sun 2009: expansion is confined to the pre-existing Ly49H+ subset and is abolished with MCMV-Dm157. Flommersfeld 2021: no bipotent clones — "progeny derived from single Ly49H+ NK cells showed limited diversification and instead adopted one of two distinct fates", i.e. fate was already fixed in the transferred cell. And PMID 40381992 (J Immunol 2025) — note its title is "Ly49G, but NOT Ly49C/I, is dispensable for diverse antigen-specific memory NK cell responses", i.e. Ly49C/I remains REQUIRED, replicating O'Leary 2006 nineteen years on, by antibody depletion of a STANDING receptor-defined subset. Selection, not conversion, on every design.

SEARCHED-AND-NOT-FOUND (G3, not "does not exist"): I ran and read (a) PubMed "NK cells not required contact hypersensitivity reassessment antigen-specific memory innate" (relevance-sorted returns were off-topic 2026 papers), (b) PubMed "conventional NK cells convert liver ILC1 CD49a adoptive transfer plasticity in vivo" (zero hits), (c) WebSearch for explicit "failed to replicate"/"could not reproduce"/controversy language on hapten NK memory — returned only reviews, one of which concedes authors "cannot fully exclude a contribution of ILC1 contamination". NO failed-replication paper found. NOT_SEARCHED BY ME: the Askenase B-1-cell/exosome CHS alternative-effector literature (the row claims to have run it with zero hits; I did not re-run it). NOT OBTAINED: methods for O'Leary 2006, Bai 2021, van den Boorn 2016, Klose 2014 — all abstract-only for me.
adv.crossfield_g4_findings:
The mechanism's home field is TISSUE RESIDENCY (TRM), and it invalidates the two assays this claim's origin half rests on.

LESSON 1 — PARABIOSIS IS A RESIDENCY ASSAY, NOT AN ONTOGENY ASSAY. Masopust D et al., J Exp Med 2010;207:553, PMID 20156972 / PMC2839151 (fetched and read; lit.py methods body truncated to 759 chars, recovered by WebFetch): their own residency evidence is intestinal TRANSPLANTATION (42 d post-transplant, minimal recirculation of host memory into graft) plus FTY720 (no reduction in TRM after 30 d); the parabiosis result is CITED from Klonowski KD et al., Immunity 2004;20:551-62, PMID 15142524, not performed. The canonical TRM is a cell that circulated, entered tissue, and then stopped recirculating. Non-equilibration in a 14-day parabiosis is EXACTLY what a converted-then-resident cell looks like. Therefore Peng 2013 (14 d, 7 pairs), Sojka 2014 (14 d, 8 pairs) and Wang 2018 (2 wk) cannot distinguish "separate lineage" from "circulating cell that converted and then stopped recirculating" — and the audited row repeats that category error by listing Sojka's parabiosis as counter-evidence (b) for a lineage claim. Same for Cuff 2016's human transplant chimerism (7 HLA-mismatched pairs + 5 explants): donor persistence proves retention, not separate ontogeny, and Cuff itself reports the cells "can be recruited from the circulation during adult life".

LESSON 2 — IN THE HOME FIELD, CIRCULATING -> RESIDENT CONVERSION IS THE DEFAULT, AND IT IS DRIVEN BY THE SAME TWO CYTOKINES. Mackay LK et al., Nat Immunol 2013;14:1294, PMID 24162776: CD103+CD8+ skin TRM "developed in the skin from epithelium-infiltrating precursor cells that lacked expression of the effector-cell marker KLRG1"; "a combination of entry into the epithelium plus local signaling by interleukin 15 (IL-15) and transforming growth factor-b (TGF-b) was required"; differentiation "resulted in the progressive acquisition of a unique transcriptional profile that differed from that of circulating memory cells". So a divergent transcriptome + integrin/retention markers + parabiosis non-equilibration is the EXPECTED signature of a CONVERTED resident cell. Sojka 2014's and Daussy 2014's inference from precisely that triad to "distinct lineage" is not licensed by home-field standards, and neither the original papers nor the audited row flags it. The convergence is exact: IL-15 (Il15ra-/- requirement in Sojka) and TGF-b (Cortez 2016/2017 PMIDs 27156386/28759002; Gao 2017 PMID 28759001) are the same two signals that install CD49a and extinguish Eomes in group-1 ILCs.

LESSON 3 — RESIDENCY IS AN INSTRUCTED TRANSCRIPTIONAL PROGRAM SHARED ACROSS UNRELATED LINEAGES, SO ITS MARKERS CANNOT BE LINEAGE MARKERS. Mackay LK et al., Science 2016;352:459, PMID 27102484: Hobit + Blimp1 "mediate the development of Trm cells in skin, gut, liver, and kidney" and the same module "is also required for other populations of tissue-resident lymphocytes, including natural killer T (NKT) cells and liver-resident NK cells, all of which share a common transcriptional program." This is OBS_GENETIC evidence, in the home field, that the liver CD49a+/CD69+/Eomes-low "resident NK" signature is a program running across at least three unrelated lineages. Using it to assign ontogeny — which is what the entire CD49a+DX5- reassignment does — is a marker-similarity inference, INF_MARKER, exactly as the row concluded but for a reason stronger than the row gives.

LESSON 4 — EVEN IN THE ILC HOME FIELD, "RESIDENT" DOES NOT MEAN "CLOSED LINEAGE". Gasteiger G, Fan X, Dikiy S, Lee SY, Rudensky AY. Science 2015;350:981, PMID 26472762: ILCs are tissue-resident and locally self-renewing, BUT "at later time points after infection, cells from hematogenous sources helped to partially replenish the pool of resident ILCs." Wang 2018's own 30% donor-derived LN ILC1 in parabionts after sensitization reproduces this.

LESSON 5 — A GATING ARTEFACT FROM THE T-CELL FIELD THAT NONE OF THESE PAPERS CONTROLLED. Anderson KG, ..., Masopust D. "Intravascular staining for discrimination of vascular and tissue leukocytes." Nat Protoc 2014;9:209, PMID 24385150. Intravenous anti-CD45 labelling minutes before harvest is required to separate vascular from parenchymal leukocytes; tissue digests conflate them. The liver is a sinusoidal organ in which a large fraction of "hepatic mononuclear cells" are intravascular. Paust 2010 used 40-um filtration + density gradient; Peng 2013 and Wang 2018 used Percoll interface; none used an i.v. label. So "hepatic NK cell" in the founding papers is an ANATOMICAL-PREPARATION category, not a verified parenchymal-residency category — an artefact route the audited row never considers, and one that also weakens the liver-vs-spleen contrast on which the whole "liver-restricted memory" claim turns.

LESSON 6 — MYELOID/TRAINED IMMUNITY: INNATE MEMORY CAN BE WRITTEN AT THE PROGENITOR LEVEL. Kaufmann E et al., "BCG Educates Hematopoietic Stem Cells to Generate Protective Innate Immunity against Tuberculosis." Cell 2018;172:176, PMID 29328912. Central trained immunity means a recall phenotype can be encoded in progenitors and read out in a mature effector that never itself met the antigen. Applied here: the transferred hepatic population's recall could reflect an imprint on hepatic progenitors — which Bai 2021 (PMID 33766856, abstract only) says exist in adult liver — rather than a memory state in the transferred mature cell. No paper in the P3 chain excludes this: none transferred progenitors, none profiled progenitor epigenetics, and the hapten transfers use bulk sorted populations at >=95% purity, which still leaves up to 5% contaminant in a functional-only readout.

NET EFFECT ON THE CLAIM: the home fields do NOT rescue the "NK" label — they make the identity question harder, because CD49a/Eomes-low/parabiosis-non-equilibration are all residency-program readouts rather than ontogeny readouts. But they also refute the audited row's confident settlement toward ILC1, because the same literature shows the ILC1 phenotype is TGF-b-inducible from cNK. What survives is: a transferable, antigen-specific, liver-restricted memory unit exists (three independent labs); its lineage label is unmeasured; and the only clean conversion test ever run in the CHS model (Wang 2018 Supp. Fig. 5c,d) came back negative, favouring selection of a pre-existing subset over conversion.

adv.load_bearing_reason:
HIGH is UPHELD, but the row's dependency list contains one dependency that is now wrong and omits the two that bite hardest.

CONCRETE NAMED DEPENDENCIES THAT SURVIVE:
(1) J Immunol 2025, PMID 40381992, "Ly49G, but not Ly49C/I, is dispensable for diverse antigen-specific memory NK cell responses in H-2d and H-2b mice." This paper exists solely to re-test O'Leary 2006's Ly49C/I result, and its entire design and title are interpretable only if O'Leary's claim stands. A 2025 experimental programme is load-bearing on a 2006 paper whose Methods no one outside a Nature subscription can read — I re-verified the paywall three ways (lit.py ABSTRACT_ONLY, nature.com 303 to idp.nature.com, Semantic Scholar openAccessPdf CLOSED). That is the sharpest load-bearing fact in this row and it should be stated as such.
(2) Mackay LK et al., Science 2016, PMID 27102484 uses "liver-resident NK cells" as one of the three exemplar populations that DEFINE the universal Hobit/Blimp1 tissue-residency program (alongside TRM and NKT). A cell-identity error in the liver group-1 compartment therefore propagates outside NK biology into the definition of lymphocyte tissue residency itself. The row does not name this dependency and it is the widest-reaching one.
(3) Bai L et al., Science 2021, PMID 33766856 — the claim that adult mouse liver sustains extramedullary hematopoiesis producing Lin-CD122+CD49a+ progenitors "that can generate liver ILC1s but not conventional natural killer cells" rests on the CD49a+ liver group-1 population being a genuine locally maintained lineage rather than a residency state.
(4) Wang 2018 PMID 30451860 and Cell Rep 2024 PMID 38363684 build the memory-ILC1 LN-liver-axis programme on the premise that the hapten memory phenomenon is real; Wang 2018's own introduction states the premise verbatim ("a liver-resident CD49a+ subset is important in this process").
(5) The scRNA-seq cell-type label "liver-resident NK" propagated into human atlases (Cuff 2016 PMID 27798170; Marquardt 2015 PMID 25672754; Cell Discov 2020 PMID 32351704).

DEPENDENCY IN THE ROW THAT MUST BE STRUCK: the row lists as dependency (2) that "Peng 2013's specific origin claim that these cells originate from hepatic HPCs/HSCs but not from the bone marrow ... is directly contradicted by Klose 2014's CHILP-origin result and by Sojka 2014." That is no longer the state of the literature. Bai 2021 (Science, PMID 33766856), from Peng/Tian with Vivier, reports fetal-liver-derived HSCs and Lin-CD122+CD49a+ progenitors in adult liver generating liver ILC1 but not cNK, via an IFN-g-dependent in-situ loop — i.e. the hepatic-origin claim was extended, not overturned. I flag under G1 that I have Bai 2021 ABSTRACT ONLY (Science 403, no PMC deposit) and did not read its Methods, so this correction is a pointer to re-audit, not a verified methods finding.

WHY NOT DOWNGRADE: the phenomenon has now been reproduced by three mutually independent labs on three different antigen systems — von Andrian (hapten + influenza/VSV/HIV-1 VLP), Tian/Peng (OXA/DNFB/FITC), and Hornung/Hartmann (monobenzone, NLRP3/ASC/IL-18-dependent, PMID 27287410) — and it anchors both the NK-directed vaccination rationale and the memory-ILC1 field. The label on the cell is what is unsupported, not the phenomenon, and a mislabelled cell type that has propagated into residency dogma and into human single-cell atlas annotations is precisely a HIGH load-bearing failure mode.
adv.better_primary_source:
The row's single primary source is wrong for the transition being graded, and the claim must be split before a primary can be named.

P3a — EXISTENCE of a transferable, antigen-specific, liver-restricted memory population in T/B-deficient mice: O'Leary JG, Goodarzi M, Drayton DL, von Andrian UH. Nat Immunol 2006;7:507-16, PMID 16617337, doi:10.1038/ni1332 remains the first primary source, and its methods are UNOBTAINABLE — I independently re-confirmed via lit.py (ABSTRACT_ONLY), WebFetch on nature.com/articles/ni1332 (303 to idp.nature.com), and the Semantic Scholar Graph API for the DOI (openAccessPdf: CLOSED, no URL). The earliest primary source in this arm whose METHODS CAN ACTUALLY BE READ is Paust S et al., Nat Immunol 2010;11:1127-35, PMID 20972432 / PMC2982944 — this part of the row is correct and should be kept.

P3b — ORIGIN of liver memory NK cells (the actual "A becomes B" transition): the correct primary source is NOT O'Leary 2006, because O'Leary transfers an already-sensitized cell and reads out ear swelling; it never observes a transition. It is Sun JC, Beilke JN, Lanier LL. "Adaptive immune features of natural killer cells." Nature 2009;457:557-61, PMID 19136945 / PMC2674434, doi:10.1038/nature07665 — full text and methods freely obtainable, congenic CD45.1 NAIVE Ly49H+ NK cells (10^4-10^5) into DAP12-deficient CD45.2 recipients, MCMV, memory pool recovered at 40-50 d with ~1000-fold expansion in the LIVER (vs ~100-fold spleen), then serially re-transferred into a second DAP12-deficient host for >100-fold secondary expansion; 3-5 mice per timepoint, representative of 3 experiments. This is the only true transfer-A-recover-B design in the claim and it is fully readable, which makes it a strictly better primary than a paywalled 2006 abstract.

P3c — IDENTITY / lineage relationship of the liver group-1 memory compartment: the best primary source is Flommersfeld S et al. "Fate mapping of single NK cells identifies a type 1 innate lymphoid-like lineage that bridges innate and adaptive recognition of viral infection." Immunity 2021;54(10), PMID 34437840 / PMC8528403, doi:10.1016/j.immuni.2021.08.002 — the only OBS_DIRECT (single-cell clonal barcoding) evidence anywhere in this claim, 82 clones across 7 independent experiments, with liver analysed. Caveat to carry forward: its lineage-separation conclusion is partly RNA-velocity-based and that portion is INF_TRAJECTORY under G2.

P3d — "It originates from hepatic HPC/HSC rather than bone marrow": current primary is Bai L et al., Science 2021;371:eaba4177, PMID 33766856 (NOT contradicted by Klose 2014 as the row asserts). Methods unobtainable to me: Science returned HTTP 403, no PMC deposit — flagged, not verified.

P3e — "Human liver-resident NK cells are the same entity": not supported; keep the row's Cuff 2016 (PMID 27798170) / Marquardt 2015 (PMID 25672754) reasoning on opposite Eomes/T-bet polarity, which I did not re-verify and record as NOT re-audited by me.
